verdict.rationale: Relay's own pricing page lists 'Recurring invoices', which is a product-native recurring scheduled action. Its other automation, auto-transfer rules, fires on each deposit rather than on a recurring schedule, so it is event-triggered and does not count as scheduling. There is no evidence of general-purpose scheduling of jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules for arbitrary jobs or workflows, scheduled recurring transfers or bill payments, documentation of recurrence configuration (frequency, start/end), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automate transfers from one to multiple accounts using dollar amounts or percentages.
